messages:
alex: Kicking off EU-WEST2 bring-up. Goal: provision dedicated GPU fleet + private VPC control-plane. Posting minimal oncall / paging config and a quick validation checklist.

maria: Sounds good — do we have PD services and escalation documented for this region yet?

alex: Pushing the minimal PD config now. This is the snippet we'll attach to the runbook and import to PagerDuty:

```
pagerduty_service: eu-west2-inference
escalation_policy:
  - step: primary_oncall
    wait: 5m
  - step: secondary_oncall
    wait: 10m
  - step: infra-sre
    wait: 15m
  - step: eng-platform
    wait: 30m
alerts:
  - name: high_gpu_util
    expr: avg_over_time(gpu_util{region="eu-west2"}[5m]) > 85
    severity: P1
    notify: pd:eu-west2-inference
  - name: node_unreachable
    expr: absent(node_up{region="eu-west2"})
    severity: P0
    notify: pd:eu-west2-inference
  - name: high_inflight_requests
    expr: sum(inflight_requests{region="eu-west2"}) > 1000
    severity: P2
    notify: pd:eu-west2-inference
```

jin: can we add auto-escalate to infra-sre -> platform -> eng? also make sure routing keys include email fallback and #eng-oncall slack channel.

leila: yes. PD route: primary -> secondary -> infra-sre -> eng-platform. Slack webhook to #eng-oncall and email alias on escalation.

sre-bot: cluster create job completed for eu-west2 (cluster-id: rwd-cl-eu2-01). runtime image rwd-runtime:v4.3. Nodes: 8xA100, 4xT4 (spot). Tags: dedicated, eu-west2, customer:internal

maria: Validation checklist (smoke run) — short and deterministic:
1) Control plane API >= 99% healthy (k8s / control-plane metrics)
2) All GPU nodes in Ready state and kernel/drivers matching image
3) p95 inference latency < 120ms for 1k token smoke prompt
4) KV cache hit rate > 10% after warmup (3 warm requests)
5) Batching latency tail check: 99th <= 400ms under 50qps synthetic load
6) Networking: egress rules to model store and KMS validated

alex: Training / handoff notes for oncall:
- 30m tabletop + 15m Q/A covering:
  * paging flow for node_down and high_gpu_util
  * how to trigger fallback to hosted model variant
  * running cache-warmup scripts and verifying KV hits
- walkthrough commands

```
# health checks
kubectl get nodes -l region=eu-west2
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-runtime -n inference
# smoke inference
curl -s -X POST \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_API_KEY' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","prompt":"smoke test"}' \ 
  https://eu-west2.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.latency'
```

jin: Cost guardrails: set billing alert when projected monthly spend > $45,000 -> notify fin-ops + ops-leads. Also set per-node hour cap for spot pool to avoid runaway costs.

leila: Added billing rule: projected_spend > 45000 => #finance-alerts and PagerDuty service fin-ops. Spot eviction fallback policy in runtime set to drain and replace on healthy nodes only.

maria: Important: pagerroute fallback -> hosted-api region: if dedicated capacity is degraded (node_unreachable or sustained high latency) then route new requests to hosted model variant. Add TTL for migration 10m.

alex: Acknowledged. I'll update the runbook with PD route + hosted fallback + training deck link. Oncall training scheduled 14:00 UTC.

oncall-team: Will attend tabletop. Quick question: who is primary owner for the first 48h after bootstrap?

alex: Ownership plan: Eng-Platform primary (alex), Infra-SRE secondary (leila) for first 48h, then normal rotation handed to oncall roster. Escalation path documented above.

maria: Quick postmortem prep: capture initial perf baseline + golden traces to compare regressions. We'll upload artifacts to internal S3 under s3://rwd-eu2-bootstrap/artifacts

alex: Thanks. I'll push final runbook link once PD routes are imported: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eu-west2-oncall

sre-bot: Reminder: tabletop scheduled at 14:00 UTC. Automated smoke runs will execute at 13:50 UTC.

oncall-team: ack. will be there :thumbsup:
